notes.title: OCO online services permanantly deactivated on 30th September 2022
notes.content:
Unfortunately GameSparks (the company hosting and managing all online data) will be closing at the end of September. There’s no easy way to migrate all the cloud code and data so I’m very sad to announce that all online OCO services will be deactivated on 30th September 2022. 

We will be releasing an OCO update in the coming months which will contain approx. 5000 of the best community levels to play through sequentially (similar to the ‘play’ level structure). If you do not wish your levels to be featured in this new version of OCO please get in touch oco@spectrum48.com

While I am very sad about the closure of the online features, I think that this new curated collection of fantastic community levels will be an exciting and compelling experience!

notes.title: OCO arrives on Steam 12th August!
notes.content:
[b]Award-nominated minimalist puzzle-platformer, ‘OCO’ arrives on Steam for PC & Mac, 12th August 2021[/b]

Launch, rush, crash, glide, warp, and hang to solve 180 unique audio-visual hand-crafted circular platforming puzzles with over 75,000 user-generated levels to explore!

Minimalist circular puzzle-platformer ‘OCO’ will launch on Steam for Windows PC and Mac on 12th August 2021 for £3.99 / €3.99 / $4.99.
